s1.desc: a snowy field with low hills and snow-capped pine trees

s2.desc: an empty space with a plain pale grey background

s3.desc: a café with an icy pale teal counter and a glass pastry case under a big shop sign

spans.view: with a red snow car on skis beside him

beats.text: Pax stands beside the red snow car holding his phone up in one flipper, looking at it
Pax stretches the phone out toward the snow car and snaps a photo with a little flash
Pax draws the phone back to his chest and glances down at it

spans.notes: a montage of nine short shots of Pax photographing things, each 20-39 frames; hard cuts at 25, 50, 75, 100, 139, 165, 191, 215 (d1 18-50, step-1 checked). Locked: motion on the tree/hill band (y0.38-0.50, x0-0.55, clouds excluded) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 f3-24. The phone is seen edge-on here (iFin unsure; the same phone shows the tuft in the café shot). The flash at f12-14 is a small local sparkle at the phone. No brand on the car; no caption or watermark

spans.view: with a hockey jersey hanging on a hanger beside him

beats.text: Pax stands beside a hockey jersey hanging on a hanger, holding his phone up to it
Pax pushes the phone toward the jersey and snaps a photo with a little flash
Pax keeps the phone raised beside the jersey and looks at it

in_world_text: team name and number on the jersey
spans.notes: locked: motion on the jersey band (y0.33-0.55, x0.05-0.40) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 f28-49. The navy jersey carries a number, an invented team name, a red hockey-helmet print and a small igloo crest (full-res crop f30): no lead print, no real brand found; treated as in-world text. Unsure only if the client counts it as Pudgy merch shown as a product

spans.view: with hanging lamps, the glass pastry case and a magazine rack behind him

beats.text: Pax stands at the café counter with a long paper receipt in one flipper, holding {ifin} up to his face with the other
Pax snaps a photo, a little flash sparkling on the back of the phone
Pax keeps holding up the phone and the dangling receipt, staring at the screen with wide eyes

spans.notes: locked: motion on the shop-sign band (y0-0.18) scale 1.0000, 0 px, cc 1.000 f53-74. The big green sign is the invented Huddlebucks café name (allowed in-world text per the curator rulings). Background is drawn soft-focus (static). Magazine covers are blurred, nothing recognisable as a lead. Phone back is pale grey with lenses and the tuft on top (full-res crop f56) = iFin
Pax photographs himself in a tall fish-shaped standing mirror; his reflection shows in the mirror the whole shot (a mirror reflection of a lead is lead_copy)

camera move under 21 frames: close-up of Polly asleep in bed, then a fast eased pull-back to the whole bed f102-118 (motion on the footboard band reaches scale 0.9753 at f119 and holds; d1 6-17 per frame falling to 0.3 at f119)
20 static frames after the pull-back (footboard band constant f119-138, d1 <= 0.3): Pax lies in bed beside the sleeping Polly holding his phone up over her. One frame short of 21

spans.view: with a round cream table and two wooden chairs

beats.text: Polly scoops up a forkful of food from her plate while Pax, sitting beside her, holds his phone up toward her
Polly lifts the fork to her beak with her eyes closed while Pax keeps the phone raised
Pax snaps a photo of Polly with a little flash as she takes the bite
Polly chews happily with her eyes closed while Pax smiles with his eyes shut, still holding up his phone

spans.notes: locked: compare 139/164 keeps the table, chairs and their shadow black (the table-base motion band is a long-line band that fits falsely, so compare decides, per the rulings). Pax's phone is held edge-on toward Polly: its screen never faces out, iFin unsure. Seated leads drawn ~21-25% of the height

U5: Pax holds his phone up for a selfie beside a grand old lady penguin with a towering curly white wig, a red gown, a gold-and-turquoise jewelled necklace and drop earrings. Her face is white and her flipper tips and the back of her head are pale pink (full-res crops f166, f190), so she is drawn on Polly's body. Polly appears as herself elsewhere in this skit, so she is someone else (not a necklace of pearls, but the same logic as Polly's mum): unfilled lookalike drop
sunset over the sea: Polly and Pax seen from behind, Pax holds up the iFin (tuft on top) and its screen shows Polly the whole shot f191-214 (a phone point of view with the other lead on its screen)
Polly sits on a toilet nibbling a snack; from f230 to the end a flipper pushes the iFin in from the right and its screen shows Polly (flash at f236). The clean part f215-229 is only 15 frames
